meta.homeTitle: Ink Atlas — a catalog of manhwa characters
meta.defaultDescription: A catalog of manhwa characters: works, portraits, short bios, and tags. A static example collection.
meta.charactersDescription: Every character in the catalog. Tags narrow the list in the browser and, without JavaScript, open their own pages.
meta.worksDescription: The works the catalog's characters belong to.
meta.tagsDescription: Tag categories: hair color, eye color, role, title, and any others you add.
meta.submitDescription: Suggest a work or a character for the catalog.

footer.lead: A static catalog. Pages are built from Markdown, so edits do not need a database.
footer.demo: The catalog currently holds demo data: fictional works and locally drawn placeholders, not panels from real manhwa.

home.lede: Manhwa characters, laid out like a shop catalog: portrait, series, and tags. Search by name and narrow the grid with filters.
home.demoBody: The names, plots, and portraits were invented for this template. Delete them and replace the files in src/content with your own.
home.featuredLead: Characters marked as featured in their files.
home.recentLead: Who arrived in the catalog after the others.
home.worksLead: The stories the characters belong to.
home.emptyFeatured: Nobody is marked as featured yet.
home.emptyRecent: No characters beyond the featured set.

characters.title: Characters
characters.lead: Everyone in the catalog. Choose a tag to narrow the list. Without JavaScript, a tag opens its own page.
characters.empty: The catalog has no characters yet.

works.title: Works
works.lead: Each card opens the story and the characters who belong to it.

work.author: Author
work.empty: This work has no characters yet.

tags.title: Tags
tags.lead: Categories live in one file. Add a category or a value without touching the layout.

filters.heading: Filter
filters.noscript: Without JavaScript this list stays complete. Open a tag in the directory to see only the matches.

fallback.notice: Some of this text is not translated yet and is shown in Russian.

form.title: Suggest an entry
form.lead: Sending this form does not publish a page. It reaches the catalog owner, who adds a Markdown file.
form.characterHint: Required if you are suggesting a character.
form.sourceHint: The manhwa page, chapter, or post the details come from.
form.tagsHint: For example: hair color — silver; title — knight.
form.emailHint: Only needed if you want a reply.
form.summary: Check the form. Some fields need attention.
form.netlifyNote: The form is marked up for Netlify Forms: on Netlify, submissions show up in the site dashboard. For GitHub Pages or Cloudflare, set a Formspree or Web3Forms URL — the README explains how.
form.formspreeNote: The suggestion is sent through Formspree.
form.web3formsNote: The suggestion is sent through Web3Forms.
form.web3formsMissing: Web3Forms is selected, but the access key is missing. Add it in site.config.json or PUBLIC_WEB3FORMS_ACCESS_KEY, or the form cannot be delivered.
form.customNote: The suggestion is sent to the address in the site settings.
form.thanksBody: If you left an email, a reply will come there. A character page appears in the catalog only after someone adds it to the files by hand.
form.success: Suggestion sent. It will not publish a page by itself — someone adds it to the catalog by hand.
form.error: Could not send. Check the fields or try again.
form.notConfigured: The form endpoint is not set yet. Add PUBLIC_FORM_ENDPOINT — the README explains how.
form.rateLimit: Too many suggestions in a row. Wait a moment and try again.
form.turnstile: Confirm you are not a robot, then send again.

validation.url: Enter a full link starting with https://.

notFound.title: No page here
notFound.body: The link is out of date, or the address has a typo. The catalog is still here — go back to the characters or the home page.
